explanation:
Lane 3 terminal verdict: INCONCLUSIVE for the complete requested kernel/hardware/packet matrix; PASS for the inspected implementation and recorded x86 Linux 7.2/6.12 routing fixtures, with no confirmed patch-introduced defect after the mandatory hostile second read (design quality 9/10; merge readiness 7/10, limited by the outstanding evidence), reviewed against head d2cf18438debba60d87ce46ba6da68bca6f072b3 plus implementation-review.diff SHA256 8e5beba17e58c94b7db47611c9192227ea580a6480b46011be5cce6420c2fc4c: the three pointer/ready pairs occupy distinct aligned ranges [-32,-1] and [-80,-65], disjoint from the LPM key [-64,-45] and domain key [-96,-81], initialization precedes every reachable cache access, pointer publication precedes ready=1, full-width reloads retain pointer provenance, and every positive-bit read follows its own NULL guard before condition-level negation; invalid families and absent MAC produce cached NULL without a helper call, family selection remains separate, R6/R7/R8 survive helper calls, and the unchanged entry-domain lookup preserves finality (crates/honk-core/src/control/routing_matcher/codegen.rs:75-93,297-314,437-450,613-733), while the fixed 128-byte/20-byte input/decision ABI and generation-owned map lifetime remain unchanged (crates/honk-ebpf-common/src/routing_policy.rs:11-43,112-135; crates/honk-core/src/ebpf/real/routing.rs:30-41,324-377).

The rejected packed-W experiment is a resolved experimental defect, not a finding against the current diff: /root/code/need-do/honk-routing-fact-cse-evidence/linux612-packed-ready-rejection.log:38-43 shows a ready=1 partial store losing scalar precision and the next ready load becoming unknown, and :613-614 records 1,000,001 processed instructions with 81,216 total states; Linux 6.12 explicitly preserves aligned immediate stores as scalar spills and restores full-width spills on reload ([verifier.c:4660-4742](https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/v6.12/kernel/bpf/verifier.c#L4660-L4742), [verifier.c:5007-5014](https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/v6.12/kernel/bpf/verifier.c#L5007-L5014)), explaining why the independent DW flags at codegen.rs:640-647 avoid repeatedly exploring impossible unready paths, with the corrected result supported by /root/code/need-do/honk-routing-fact-cse-evidence/linux612-routing.log:2-12 and host-routing-gate-dw-ready.log:7-17 reporting 7/7 passes; the earlier 7.2-only success was demonstrably insufficient, and the corrected passes establish acceptance of those fixture shapes, not a universal verifier-state bound for arbitrary policies.

Unresolved evidence, not additional code defects: publish_compiled_routing really loads the LAN/WAN L2/L3 classifiers and attaches the extension to all four targets before publishing the descriptor (crates/honk-core/src/ebpf/real/routing.rs:16-21,281-311,324-356), but execution/timing goes through routing_test with canonical input and therefore bypasses packet parsing and production process normalization (crates/honk-core/src/ebpf/real/routing.rs:425-444; crates/honk-ebpf/src/route.rs:115-145,192-205; /root/code/need-do/honk-routing-fact-cse-evidence/root_probe.rs:34-96); acceptance still needs recorded cold-route TCP/UDP IPv4/IPv6 LAN/WAN L2/L3 packet results exercising the consumers at crates/honk-ebpf/src/ingress.rs:704-746 and egress.rs:392-420,710-739, the requested actual ARM/lab and complete netns/integration gates, and successful-load verifier statistics if claiming capacity headroom, because the existing 256-destination/source/MAC fixture and separate 256-domain fixture do not establish every combined domain/process/negated capacity shape, the 65,537-prefix fixture contains only one uncached destination condition (crates/honk-core/src/ebpf/real/routing/tests.rs:586-614,645-710), and the existing datapath fixture loads classifiers without publishing generated policies and tests cached/DNS bypasses rather than closing this gap (crates/honk-core/tests/ebpf_datapath_test.rs:77-126,536-716); no source fix is requested, no pre-existing issue is relabeled as introduced, and no validation or unrecorded ARM/lab result is claimed.
